start.name_en: PipeChina West-2 Line, Guigang–Yulin Branch, Valve Chamber No. 5

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '城隍镇,兴业县,玉林' (Chenghuang Town, the Xingye County seat) — town-level proxy only, NOT the station's own coordinates. The station itself is documented as sitting on the G80 Guangkun Expressway's Xingye connector line (兴业连接线), right side, K7+950–K7+970, within Xingye County — no OSM/Nominatim entry for the station or the connector-line milepost exists, so Chenghuang Town (the county's administrative/population center) is the finest resolvable point.

corridor_notes: Short (~8km per GEM) feeder from a valve-chamber tie-in on PipeChina's West-2 Line Guigang–Yulin branch (5# valve chamber, gas taken from its reserved distribution outlet) east/southeast to the Xingye distribution station sited on the G80 Guangkun Expressway's Xingye connector line (K7+950–K7+970), Xingye County, Yulin — both points sit within Xingye County given the short length.
researcher_notes: MAJOR UPDATE to the prior researcher's existence concern: a fresh search surfaced a Guangxi Investment Group e-procurement (gigeps.com) feasibility/design-consulting tender, '兴业天然气支线管道工程-西二线贵玉支线5#阀室分输改造工程可行性研究技术咨询和设计服务' (Xingye Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Engineering — West-2 Line Guiyu Branch 5# Valve Chamber Redistribution Modification Project, code GCJS-2025002, posted 2025-02-25), which explicitly names this pipeline, states it runs from the West-2 Line's Guigang–Yulin branch 5# valve chamber to the Xingye distribution station, and gives Diameter=D273.1mm and Pressure=6.3MPa. CROSS-CHECKED against the live GEM GGIT sheet (P7655, row 4054/CSV idx 4050): Diameter=273 and Pressure=6.30 MPa are ALREADY on the row — an exact match to the tender's D273.1mm/6.3MPa — but the sheet's only ref for Pressure is the dead-403 gas.in-en.com link the prior researcher flagged; this gigeps tender is a working, independent replacement corroborating that same value and should be swapped in on a future Update pass (out of scope here — endpoints only). A second gigeps.com notice (79585.htm, a road-access safety-evaluation tender for the Xingye station's entrance) independently corroborates the station's existence and pins its location to the G80 Xingye connector line, K7+950–970, citing an existing road-traffic permit (桂交玉林 11/2023) due for renewal by 2026-04-12 — active permit-renewal activity is itself evidence the facility is a real, currently-operating asset (matches sheet Status=operating). A THIRD gigeps.com notice (77172.htm, an earlier/parallel version of the same road-safety-evaluation tender) independently repeats the same station/permit/location details, giving three separate independent postings in total. All three URLs verified live via url_verifier.py (200 + expected content). This resolves the EXISTENCE concern: the pipeline is real and under active engineering/procurement activity — recommend the prior existence flag be downgraded/cleared. What remains unresolved is PRECISE geocoding: no source gives GPS/lat-lon for either the 5# valve chamber or the station itself, and neither appears in OSM/Nominatim. The Xingye distribution station is anchored to a named road milepost (G80 Xingye connector K7+950–970) but not a mappable point; Nominatim confirms Chenghuang Town (城隍镇) is a real, separately-named place within Xingye County (22.603969, 109.734702) and is the county seat, used here as the best available town-level proxy. The valve chamber has no location description beyond 'on the Guigang–Yulin branch' (a corridor that runs roughly Guigang → Xingye → Yulin, so it is presumably a few km outside Xingye town along that corridor, but nothing found names a village/township for it). Web-search budget was exhausted this session before the Yulin '两湾' regional plan (ybj.gxzf.gov.cn) or yanshougs.com could be re-checked; both remain open leads.
blockers: Existence and named endpoints (5# valve chamber → Xingye distribution station) are now well-sourced (3 independent gigeps.com postings) and spec-matched against the live sheet (Diameter/Pressure both confirmed), but neither endpoint could be geocoded to better than town-level (used Xingye County's seat, Chenghuang Town, as the nearest resolvable point for the station; the valve chamber has no coordinate or sub-county place name in any source found). Not precise enough for a real two-point route without further sourcing (e.g. Amap/Baidu satellite spotting of the G80 K7+950-970 milepost, or the underlying feasibility-study PDF if it can be located). This session's WebSearch budget was exhausted before ybj.gxzf.gov.cn (Yulin regional gas-branch plan) or yanshougs.com could be re-checked for the valve chamber's township — try those next, plus fgw.gxzf.gov.cn via VPN/China-based access (geo-blocked here).
